title: Breadcrumbs
lede: Navigation aid that shows the user's location within a site's hierarchy, with text and menu variants.

examples.heading: Default
Active
Disabled
Menu states
examples.description: The menu type's active and disabled chips have no rendered example (the page shows them on the text type only); their class strings come from the component's client code: the active chip is white with a gray-600 border and gray-1000 text, the disabled chip is a disabled button with a gray-alpha-200 fill and gray-700 text.

examples.heading: Links
examples.description: Crumbs that navigate have no rendered example; the class strings come from the component's client code. A text crumb holds a plain anchor (inheriting the color, no underline, a 2px radius, the focus ring as its shadow); a menu crumb rendered as an anchor (the as prop) carries the chip's classes itself.
